title: Divine Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom
note: Choir parts in service order. 'cues' are opening words used to locate each part in the transcript (fuzzy-matched, in order). 'variable' parts change with the Sunday tone or feast. 'spoken' parts (homily, announcements) are labelled so they can be found and removed later.

parts.name: Great Litany
cues: in peace let us pray to the lord

parts.name: First Antiphon
cues: through the prayers of the theotokos
bless the lord o my soul
it is good to give thanks

parts.name: Second Antiphon
cues: save us o son of god
praise the lord o my soul
glory to the father and to the son

parts.name: Only-Begotten Son
cues: only begotten son and word of god

parts.name: Third Antiphon / Beatitudes
cues: blessed are the poor in spirit

parts.name: Little Entrance — Come, Let Us Worship
cues: come let us worship and bow down before christ

parts.name: Troparia & Kontakia
cues: when the stone had been sealed

parts.name: Trisagion — Holy God
cues: holy god holy and mighty holy and immortal

parts.name: Gospel Responses
cues: glory to you o lord glory to you

parts.name: Homily
cues: glory to jesus christ glory forever
in the name of the father and of the son and of the holy spirit amen

parts.name: Litany of Fervent Supplication
cues: let us all say with our whole soul
lord have mercy lord have mercy lord have mercy

parts.name: Litany for the Departed
cues: have mercy on us o god

parts.name: Litany for the Catechumens
cues: pray to the lord you catechumens

parts.name: Litanies of the Faithful
cues: again and again in peace let us pray

parts.name: Cherubic Hymn (part 1)
cues: let us who mystically represent the cherubim

parts.name: Cherubic Hymn (part 2) — That We May Receive
cues: that we may receive the king of all
invisibly escorted by the angelic hosts

parts.name: Litany of Supplication
cues: let us complete our prayer to the lord

parts.name: Father, Son, and Holy Spirit
cues: the father and the son and the holy spirit
the trinity one in essence and undivided
i will love you o lord my strength

parts.name: Symbol of Faith (Creed)
cues: i believe in one god the father almighty

parts.name: A Mercy of Peace
cues: a mercy of peace a sacrifice of praise

parts.name: Anaphora dialogue — It Is Proper and Just
cues: we have lifted them up to the lord

parts.name: Holy, Holy, Holy (Sanctus)
cues: holy holy holy lord of hosts

parts.name: We Praise You
cues: we praise you we bless you we thank you

parts.name: Hymn to the Theotokos — It Is Truly Proper
cues: it is truly proper to glorify you

parts.name: And for All Mankind
cues: and for all and for everything

parts.name: Our Father
cues: our father who art in heaven
our father who are in heaven
who art in heaven hallowed be thy name
give us this day our daily bread
forgive us our trespasses as we forgive those who trespass against us

parts.name: One Is Holy
cues: one is holy one is lord jesus christ

parts.name: Communion Hymn
cues: praise the lord from the heavens

parts.name: Communion of the Faithful
cues: blessed is he who comes in the name of the lord
the lord is god and has revealed himself to us

parts.name: We Have Seen the True Light
cues: we have seen the true light
we have received the heavenly spirit
we have found the true faith

parts.name: May Our Mouths Be Filled
cues: may our mouths be filled with your praise

parts.name: Blessed Be the Name of the Lord
cues: blessed be the name of the lord now and forever
blessed be the name of the lord

parts.name: Dismissal
cues: glory to the father and to the son
lord have mercy lord have mercy lord have mercy

parts.name: Prayers of Thanksgiving after Communion
cues: now you may dismiss your servant
now you let your servant go in peace
you may dismiss your servant lord
i thank you for you have not rejected me
